emma: Quick sync reminder for 1pm PT 1: align vendor ETAs + marketplace staging for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Main asks: firmware freeze windows, embargo sequencing, SI test handoffs, and regional power caps.

kai: invite sent. agenda short: 1) freeze dates 2) SI cert gates 3) marketplace metadata schema + region limits 4) rollback/fallback policy.

nate: perf note 1: H200 long-seq still showing thermal throttling in eu-west racks. we need vendor-supplied thermal counters + a potential power-limit patch.

sylvia: labs: we can host multi-node MI300 runs Tue-Wed next week if signed canaries arrive Mon EOD. need vendor release notes attached.

vendor-bot: Published tags (tentative): h100-fw-2024-09-04, h200-canary:v20240906, b200-image:v20240905, mi300-fw-2024-09-01, gaudi-driver:v2.3.

emma: marketplace schema ask: add fields max_seq, recommended_quant, fallback_model_tag, region_power_limit. will open PR after call.

kai: marketing asked for a 7-day embargo buffer after driver freeze. vendors, please confirm freeze targets in-thread.

nate: propose fallback rule: if H200 long-seq regression >8% vs baseline, preview traffic routes to fallback_model_tag (b200-stable) until fix. thoughts?

sylvia: +1. also need vendors to enable thermal-export at 50ms sampling for correlation with infra traces.

vendor-bot: H200 canary includes thermal-exporter v0.4 (sampling configurable to 50ms). canary image: rwinf/h200/canary:v20240906.

ops-bot: Note: eu-west racks have sustained power cap 8% lower than us-west cluster. set region_power_limit accordingly in SKU metadata.

kai: draft timeline (rough):
- H100/B200: canary Sep 6-7 -> driver freeze Sep 10 -> marketplace preview Sep 18 -> public Sep 25
- H200: canary Sep 8-10 -> perf validation Sep 11-15 -> driver freeze Sep 16 -> preview Sep 25 -> public Oct 2
- MI300/Gaudi: canary Sep 12-16 -> extended perf Sep 17-23 -> driver freeze Sep 24 -> preview Oct 1 -> public Oct 8

emma: action items: 1) vendors reply "ACK + freeze tag" (vendors) 2) perf run on canaries (nate) 3) labs carve + signed images (sylvia) 4) schema PR (kai) 5) draft fallback language for marketplace (emma).

vendor-bot: Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.ai/partners/1748888888. Reminder emailed to vendor leads.

emma: Please reply in-thread with "ACK + tag" so we can lock embargo windows. I'll post minutes after the call. :white_check_mark:
